note: This guide shows the original BBS by McHorse. BBS Renewed looks different, but everything works the same way.

chapters.title: Intro
chapters.here: A short overview of what BBS can do — nothing to look for yet.

chapters.title: Requirements
chapters.here: What you need installed. You're running BBS already, so you're set.

chapters.title: Setup
chapters.here: Settings live behind the gear icon in the top right corner.

chapters.title: Basics
chapters.here: Replays are listed in the Outliner, top left. Record one with Record replay in the timeline bar.

chapters.title: Intermediary
chapters.here: Keyframes and replay settings sit in the Properties area, bottom left.

chapters.title: Advanced
chapters.here: Rig controls moved to the Rig tab on the right edge of the viewport.

chapters.title: Model blocks
chapters.here: Model blocks have their own workspace — the Blocks tab in the top bar.

chapters.title: Forms
chapters.here: Forms are picked and edited in the Morphing workspace in the top bar.

chapters.title: Camera clips
chapters.here: Camera clips live in the timeline — set the menu at its top left to Camera clips.

chapters.title: Outro
chapters.here: That's the whole tour. Features added in this version have their own short clips.

guides.title: The Ultimate Guide to BBS mod
guides.author: McHorse

shorts.title: A tour of the new interface
shorts.text: Where everything went, if you come from BBS or BBS FS.

shorts.title: Recording guide
shorts.text: Marks where and when each actor starts, so every take lines up.

shorts.title: Voice-over
shorts.text: Record your voice onto the film's timeline, with the film itself muted while you speak.

shorts.title: DaVinci Resolve tab
shorts.where: Top bar › Resolve, with BBS Link
shorts.text: Opens DaVinci Resolve inside BBS and keeps both timelines in step.

shorts.title: Held model block
shorts.text: Animate the model block in your first-person hand as its own Held replay.

shorts.title: Texture Studio
shorts.text: Paint a texture in Photopea inside BBS with a live 3D preview. Needs the Rinku mod.

shorts.title: Smooth UI scale
shorts.text: In-between sizes like 1.5, and the interface follows the slider while you drag.

shorts.title: Film tile scrubbing
shorts.where: Film list › move the mouse over a tile
shorts.text: Slide across a film tile to look through the film without opening it.

shorts.title: Help inside BBS
shorts.text: A tour of this Help: the chapter for your editor, Show me, and clips at features.
